meta.title: Assembly DSP — CHUNK
meta.description: CHUNK is a multiband channel processor from Assembly DSP. EQ, COMP, and spectral RS on one graph. $39 launch price. 14-day free trial.

hero.lede: A multiband channel processor — Preamp, EQ, Multiband Compressor, Multiband Resonance Suppressor, Clipper.

product.headline: Start at the top. A channel strip.
product.lede: CHUNK stacks input saturations, phase alignment, an 8-band EQ, 6-band compressor, a 4-band spectral resonance suppressor (RS), stereo widener, and a brickwall limiter / clipper on a shared spectrum view — so you carve, control, and clean in one streamlined workflow.

layers.headline: One graph. Ten jobs.
layers.eqBody: Bell, shelves, high/low pass, and plateau filters — drag nodes on the spectrum, and solo bands to hear the frequency you're working on.
layers.eqAlt: CHUNK EQ window — multiband equalizer with spectrum graph and band controls
layers.compHeadline: Six-band dynamics with per-band sidechain and gate.
layers.compBody: Threshold, ratio, attack, release, knee, makeup, range, and gate per region — plus external sidechain per band..
layers.compAlt: CHUNK COMP window — multiband compressor with transfer curve and dynamics controls
layers.rsHeadline: Spectral frequency suppression to tame resonances.
layers.rsBody: RS lets you create up to 4 regions, and splits each region into ~80 narrow log-spaced bands that compress independently — gain reduction traces the inverse of the spectrum for transparent leveling and resonance control.  Each region has Threshold, Speed, and Ratio controls.
layers.rsAlt: CHUNK RS window — resonance suppressor with spectral gain reduction

extras.headline: Input color. Output polish.
extras.item1: Input & outputs both have saturation. Toggle even/odd harmonics.
extras.item2: Stereo width and continuous phase control
extras.item3: Output ceiling / brickwall for clean peaks
extras.item4: Live spectrum analyzer under every layer
extras.item5: VST3 for Windows (macOS AU coming later)

pricing.headline: Launch pricing.
pricing.lede: Full license, 14-day free trial — no commitment while you put it on real sessions.
pricing.note: Launch offer · Regular price $79 · 14-day free trial
